jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(2)(E) inventory: Winooski School District, an incorporated (city) district that is its own supervisory district (member: City of Winooski). Operates PK-12. Board fixed by its charter, 16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23.

board.post_note: Winooski SD: five trustees elected at large under its charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23 section 23-2) -- three seats at 3-year terms and two at 2-year terms.

sources.note: Winooski SD School Board page (official, re-verified 2026-10-22): Mace (President) "3 Year Term Expires: 3/2029"; Millar (Vice President) 3-year exp. 3/2028; Essiba 2-year exp. 3/2028; Bowers 2-year exp. 3/2027; Livermore (Secretary) "(Interim/3 Year Term Expires: 3/2027)." The charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23 section 23-2) fixes five trustees elected at large -- three 3-year seats and two 2-year seats -- matching the page's seat classes exactly, and empowers the board to appoint to a vacancy until an election fills the remainder. Livermore took Isaiah Donaldson's seat mid-term in fall 2025 (he is listed in the October 2025 newsletter; she attends from Nov. 12, 2025) and the district's own page still labels her Interim -- minted APPOINTED (interim). The appointment record was located 2026-10-29: the minutes of the Sept. 29, 2025 special meeting (indexed on the district's minutes page, which labels them '(Unofficial)') record the appointment, and are cited on Livermore's own membership, recorded per Walter's 2026-10-29 ruling (the Jay/Whitaker unofficial-minutes precedent). Excluded: Allyssa Ravelin, the elected District Treasurer under section 23-3(2)(D) (a district officer, not a trustee), and two student members. Donaldson gets no ended record -- his departure mechanism is undocumented.

directors.name: Emily Bowers
directors.note: 2-year seat. Same person as the Winooski justice of the peace record.

directors.name: Katie Livermore
directors.note: Secretary; APPOINTED (interim) Sept. 29, 2025 under the charter's vacancy power -- the appointment is recorded in the Sept. 29, 2025 special meeting minutes; see her sources. The seat's term expires March 2027.

sources.note: Winooski SD School Board page (official, re-verified 2026-10-22): Livermore (Secretary) "(Interim/3 Year Term Expires: 3/2027)" -- the district's own page labels her Interim under the charter's vacancy appointment power (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 23 section 23-2). She took Isaiah Donaldson's seat mid-term in fall 2025 (he is listed in the October 2025 newsletter; she attends from Nov. 12, 2025).

Minutes of the Winooski School Board of Trustees special meeting, Monday, September 29, 2025 (district-posted PDF; the district's board-minutes index labels the document "(Unofficial)"): under item 9 (Appointment of Trustee) the board entered executive session at 6:56 pm to deliberate appointing a board member to fill the vacancy, returned at 7:27 pm, and Robert Millar moved "that we appointment Katie Livermore on the board." The minutes do not separately record the vote on the motion; Erik Johnson (WSD District Office Manager) confirmed by email on 2026-10-29 that a vote was taken at that meeting with regard to appointing Kate Livermore. Recorded per Walter's ruling of 2026-10-29 (unofficial-labeled minutes accepted -- the Jay/Whitaker precedent), with the label and the unrecorded vote disclosed here. Her start is the appointment date, 2025-09-29.
